title: A desktop and a presentation are different commitments
scope: Presentation preparation, persistent desktop appearance and optional reuse between them. This contract does not change dictation, reading or annotation lifecycles.

statusMeaning.implemented: Verified in source and the stated local checks; this is not a claim that the newest binary is publicly released.
statusMeaning.proposed: A product contract for review and implementation. No corresponding feature is promised in the current download.

principles: Each job must be useful on its own. Wallpaper must not require creating a phone presentation.
Reuse an original image by choice. Keep each job's crop, layout and playback settings independent.
Make the first useful action obvious; reveal adjustments in context. Do not require an expert setup screen.
Presentation is video from a device into a Mac window. It does not send Mac input to the phone or manage a meeting.
Preserve the person's later manual desktop choice. Ending a presentation is not Restore desktop.

capabilities.name: Change a scene backdrop
capabilities.effect: Preview a file, starter or saved scene image with the retained foreground; apply only the background and crop.
capabilities.limit: Changes the saved scene and later outputs, not a running presentation or an already-applied desktop image.
capabilities.evidence: Six focused tests with 126 assertions; native picker Cancel, Escape, Return Apply and missing-image repair checked with disposable scenes.

capabilities.name: Present a prepared scene
capabilities.entry: Present full screen / Present in window
capabilities.effect: Show device video within a saved composition in a Mac window, with contextual phone-tile controls.
capabilities.limit: A meeting app chooses what to share. An audience view, USB recovery and a second display need their own checks.
capabilities.evidence: At da4f0f4, saved name/backdrop/persona edits left a running windowed still unchanged; End/restart adopted them. At 7e45213, the unchanged isolated native host verified all eight expanded positions, a compact-tile drag to Left centre, keyboard reveal and Escape collapse/End through a full-screen transition. Device capture and cloud were off; this is not receiver-view or installed signed-shell verification.

capabilities.name: Apply a scene as a desktop picture
capabilities.entry: Present a device → More → Use as desktop (Preview build)
capabilities.effect: Render the whole scene to a retained PNG, record recovery information and request the desktop change through macOS.
capabilities.limit: Includes foreground artwork; it is not a background-photo-only picker. Uses the editor window's display or the main display. No dedicated display chooser. Excluded from APP_STORE builds.
capabilities.evidence: Source verifies journal-before-write and URL readback; this documentation change did not alter the user's desktop.

capabilities.name: Restore a previous desktop picture
capabilities.entry: Restore desktop when recovery information exists
capabilities.effect: Restore recorded image/options only where the current picture still matches a Workbench-owned output.
capabilities.limit: Retains unmatched recovery records. It is not a complete snapshot of Apple's dynamic, aerial, rotation, screen-saver or arbitrary Space configuration.
capabilities.evidence: Recovery planning has deterministic tests; multi-display and multi-Space behavior requires native validation.

capabilities.name: Choose a wallpaper without preparing a scene
capabilities.entry: A direct Wallpaper entry; final placement to be tested
capabilities.effect: Choose a picture, preview its fit on a named display and apply it. Keep a separate wallpaper preference and previous-picture recovery.
capabilities.limit: No dedicated wallpaper manager exists yet. Do not introduce login launch, scheduling, a sidebar category or an asset migration merely to ship this first job.
capabilities.evidence: Next proof: a first-time user sets and restores a picture without opening a scene editor; another can use only Dictate without seeing wallpaper setup.

capabilities.name: Reuse a picture between the two jobs
capabilities.entry: An explicit Use this picture action in the relevant picker
capabilities.effect: Reference the same original through two independent saved configurations. A still frame may accompany future motion assets.
capabilities.limit: No live synchronization of crop or playback. Existing scene-image reuse is implemented; cross-job wallpaper reuse is not.
capabilities.evidence: Proof: edit, remove and export each configuration independently; preserve originals referenced by the other job or recovery.

capabilities.name: Gentle desktop motion, while Workbench is open
capabilities.entry: Present a device → More beside the presentation buttons → Use as animated desktop (non-App-Store build)
capabilities.effect: Apply and verify the rendered scene as a native still, then show an independent click-through desktop layer. Only the photograph slowly zooms; foreground artwork stays still. Pause/Resume/Stop controls appear in the scene window.
capabilities.limit: App-owned, one display and the current Space only. Stops on Quit or Space change; checks native wallpaper ownership periodically. A direct photo-only wallpaper picker is still proposed. No video import, Lock Screen installation, automatic login restart or energy claim.
capabilities.evidence: Native isolated Mac host checked desktop-layer Start/Pause/Resume/Stop and presentation-End independence without changing the user’s wallpaper. Ownership, nested sleep and removal policies passed unit checks. Actual native still apply is separately implemented; physical multi-display/Spaces and energy remain unverified. The signed Mac Preview at source 9fe7959 was installed and opened with existing scenes present; the new toggle and desktop menu action were confirmed. It is not notarized or in the public download.

capabilities.name: Gentle motion in a prepared scene
capabilities.entry: Gentle motion beside the scene settings; Pause/Play in presentation controls or the iOS editor preview
capabilities.effect: Opt into a 3.5% photograph-only zoom over 24 seconds each way. Persist the setting in existing portable scenes. Foreground artwork and PNG exports remain still.
capabilities.limit: Mac editor and gallery stay still. iOS animates only the active, visible scene preview; Wallpaper export is a separate still-image job. Reduce Motion, Low Power Mode and serious/critical thermal state suppress animation. Device video and meeting receivers require their own validation.
capabilities.evidence: 74 Mac scene checks / 2098 assertions, 73 shared-store tests and 14 focused iPhone Simulator tests passed. Native Mac before/after captures changed the photo while an opaque logo region stayed identical; native iPhone Pause/Play and still crop controls were checked.

events.label: End presentation
events.stops: The presentation window, its device capture, controls and keep-awake activity.
events.keeps: Saved scenes, original assets, any independently applied desktop picture and a separately started desktop-motion session.
events.check: Do not restore wallpaper, close a meeting, move unrelated windows or change system Stage Manager settings. Check focus returns sensibly; do not promise an exact previous app is always restored.

events.label: Restore desktop
events.stops: The app-owned desktop-motion layer immediately, then use of Workbench’s still output on eligible matched displays after macOS confirms restoration.
events.keeps: A later manual picture choice, unmatched recovery records and any active presentation.
events.check: Read the current desktop before restoring. A recorded old URL is not authority to overwrite a later user choice.

events.label: Change a picture in System Settings
events.stops: The desktop-motion layer at its next ownership check if the native picture no longer matches the applied output. macOS owns the new choice.
events.keeps: A running presentation and saved compositions. Restoration subsequently skips pictures it no longer owns.
events.check: The renderer never reapplies a picture. A five-second timer with tolerance and wake checks verify ownership; unknown state stops the session. Restore still respects later manual choices.

events.label: Pause wallpaper motion
events.stops: The desktop layer’s animation and visibility; the underlying native still shows.
events.keeps: The applied still, independent saved scene and any presentation. Resume checks that Workbench still owns the desktop picture.
events.check: Explicit Pause survives sleep/wake. Reduce Motion, Low Power Mode, high thermal state and occlusion separately suppress animation. No automatic login restart.

events.label: Quit Workbench
events.stops: App-owned recording, playback, presentation, drawing, timers and monitors.
events.keeps: Saved work, retained desktop output files and recovery records. A still picture set through macOS remains set.
events.check: App-rendered desktop motion stops on Quit; the native still remains. Do not restart in the background or restore wallpaper silently.

acceptance.test: At da4f0f4, start a windowed synthetic still in the native Mac host, change the saved name/backdrop and remove the placed persona, then revisit the running presentation. It stayed unchanged; End/restart adopted the saved changes. Device capture and cloud were off. Live video, incoming sync, fullscreen and receiving-participant behavior remain unverified.

At 7e45213, select each of the eight named positions in an isolated native windowed still presentation; Position and End stayed reachable. Drag the compact tile from Bottom right to Left centre; release kept it collapsed with no guides remaining. Command Slash reopened it. A native full-screen transition retained controls; first Escape collapsed them, second Escape ended and returned to Scenes. Every drag target, guides during drag, multiple displays, VoiceOver, live capture and receiver views remain separate.
Set a wallpaper from a fresh session without making a presentation. Complete first dictation without wallpaper setup.
Use the same source in both jobs, crop each differently, end a scene and relaunch. Preserve each choice and referenced media.
Apply a still, manually change it in System Settings, then Restore. Preserve the manual choice and report any pending recovery accurately.
Two displays and two Spaces; Show on all Spaces on/off; disconnect and reconnect. Record affected surfaces rather than inferring them.
Check typing destination, desktop clicks, Mission Control and Stage Manager during apply, start, end and future motion. Wallpaper must not take keyboard focus.
Observe a receiving participant in Teams and Zoom, desktop and browser versions, for window and whole-display sharing. Test separate overlays and control menus.
Measure idle CPU/GPU/energy, battery, sleep/wake and Reduce Motion on named hardware before choosing defaults or advertising animation.

Native Mac windowed motion, Pause, desktop-layer Pause/Resume/Stop and End independence checked using disposable scenes. iPhone Simulator created Coast, enabled motion, paused/resumed and opened still crop controls. The desktop host used the existing native wallpaper as its ownership token and did not replace it. Current source builds pass; full device-video, Lock Screen, multi-display and energy checks remain separate.

agentContract.kind: read-only product specification; not a command endpoint
beforeWork: Read docs/workbench.md and this contract, then inspect the current implementation and release state.
Choose one capability ID and a bounded user outcome. Agree a new surface or storage migration before implementing it.
Identify changed source owners, durable state, system effects and evidence needed. Concepts are not instructions to reproduce every pictured control.
handoff: Tests actually run, including hardware/receiver limitations
agentContract.execution: Use only supported authorized app or development tools. No wallpaper CLI, wallpaper App Intent, MCP server or remote agent integration is provided by this document.
